name: pdk-tinytag-etl
instr:
We're cataloguing a label's back catalogue with tinytag (the checkout in /app), and many files come out wrong: TinyTag.get gives missing or garbled titles, comments and cover art, and some values land in `other` under junk names. Other players read the same tags fine. A sample is in /data/archive: mostly MP3, plus WAV and AIFF files with ID3 chunks and FLAC files with an ID3 tag in front, tagged over the years by several tools.

For every file, TinyTag.get should return the same fields, `other` values and images that a plain ID3 tag holding the same frames gives today, with the duration and other audio properties unchanged. Some frames are encrypted and a few have damaged compressed data. Those frames should be left out without an error, and the rest of the tag still read. `python -m tinytag` should then still print the file's metadata and exit with status 0, and write one stderr line per left-out frame containing the file path as given on the command line and the frame ID, like `/data/archive/song.mp3: TPUB left out`.

Could you find what's going wrong and fix it? The existing tests in /app/tinytag/tests and the project's pycodestyle, pylint and mypy checks (with the current settings in /app/pyproject.toml) have to keep passing. There's no network here; the project and its dev tools are installed in /opt/venv.
